description: Spot prices for up to 10 crypto symbols in one call, quoted in the currency you name (default USD). Each price names the venue that answered (Coinbase spot, Kraken ticker as fallback) and the exact URL it was read from, and every symbol that could not be priced is listed in gaps instead of being guessed or silently dropped. Use it to price an asset before a transfer, mark a position, or check a quote your counterparty gave you. Paid per call via x402 (USDC on Base, no account, no API key). 【価格】0.00 USDC。【使い方】呼ぶと 402 と PAYMENT-REQUIRED（支払い条件）が返る。USDC で支払い、同じ引数に PAYMENT-SIGNATURE ヘッダを添えて再送すると結果が返る。
name: crypto-price
